known_risk_areas.description: Large modular manifest must remain synchronized with backend endpoints and actual repository files.
Relationship-first architecture requires every important endpoint to resolve through nodes, country indexes or explicit bridges.
Visible labels and cards can exist in backend registries without a substantive node page; route coverage must be tested separately from dataset existence.
Country overlays, registries, expansions and research files can legitimately repeat IDs; duplicates must be classified rather than blindly deleted.
Counts such as 195/195 indicate coverage scaffolding, not substantive research depth.
Religious lexicons, registries, foundations, comparative libraries, text libraries and relationship maps require canonical ownership and reciprocal routes.
New intelligence/security/extremism datasets must be integrated into the canonical graph rather than remaining isolated registries.
North Programme evidence, theory, spiritual canon and empirical geopolitical records must remain connected but epistemically distinct.
Complete texts must be distinguished from metadata catalogues and linked copyrighted editions.
Optional live data must never blank repository-backed navigation.

rule: This report is intentionally not a declaration of repository health. Passing one validator does not prove the whole Atlas is complete. Phase 1 remains active until structural, graph, route, provenance and consumer audits pass together.
